title: FishUI - Renderer and input agnostic C# gui
author: Cartman300
selftext:
This is my GUI library that i developed for some of my personal projects over time. Mostly based for game development, but also for applications with fancy GUI controls.

It's written in C#, it's based on [GWEN](https://github.com/garrynewman/GWEN) and it's MIT licensed. You can use it for whatever you want if you think it might fit.

If you encounter any problem or bug, just open an issue and i will fix it when i catch some free time.

Suggestions and custom control ideas are welcome, i would be very happy if this shortened development time for someone. 

https://github.com/sbarisic/FishUI
